name: Oman Australia Cable (OAC) landing station - West Island
notes: Telecom/cable landing station lead per CC methodology, NOT a commercial datacenter. OAC ready-for-service (Oman Observer quoting SUBCO, B+); landing points include Perth, West Island Cocos (Keeling) Islands, Muscat; operational since 2022. Verified negatives as of 2026-08-12: no commercial colocation/carrier hotel, no cloud region (AWS/Azure/GCP/OCI official lists have no CC region), no AI/HPC or hyperscale facility; nbn Sky Muster satellite access (nbn official) and MultiWave resale are access services only, not local facilities; Home Island diesel/wind power station is power infrastructure, not a DC; Direction Island 1901 telegraph station is historical and not counted.
